units.source_text: 岛村正在翻译瓦勒里［保尔·瓦勒里（１８７１—１９４５），法国象征派诗人、评论家］和阿阑［阿阑（１８６８—１９５１），法国哲学家、评论家］的作品，

en.t: Shimamura was translating works by Valéry, Paul Valéry, 1871 to 1945, the French Symbolist poet and critic, and Alain, 1868 to 1951, the French philosopher and critic,

units.source_text: 还有俄国舞蹈盛行时期法国文人墨客的舞蹈理论，

en.t: as well as writings on dance theory by French literary figures from the period when Russian ballet was in vogue,

units.source_text: 打算印很少的一些精装本自费出版。

en.t: intending to have a very small number of deluxe copies printed and publish them at his own expense.

units.source_text: 这些书对于今天的日本舞蹈界恐怕没有什么用处。

en.t: These books were probably of little use to the Japanese dance world of today.

units.source_text: 要说这一点，反而使他感到放心，也未尝不可。

en.t: One might even say that this, on the contrary, gave him a sense of relief.

units.source_text: 通过自己的工作来嘲笑自己，恐怕也是一种撒娇的乐趣吧。

en.t: To mock himself through his own work was perhaps a kind of self-indulgent pleasure.

units.source_text: 说不定由此可以产生他那悲哀的梦幻世界，

en.t: Perhaps from this there could arise his sad, dreamlike world,

units.source_text: 所以也就毫无必要急于出来旅行了。

en.t: and so there was no need at all for him to hurry out on a journey.
